content.comment_body: I need guidance on scaling a 4-20 mA sensor to a 0-16 bar range. The offset appears to be 400, and when the analog input reads zero, it starts from -4. Is there a solution for correcting this?
Why did you contact me via private message when you're also posting your question here on the forum? Here are the recommended settings for your declarations with two decimal places for the display.

It's good forum etiquette to avoid writing entirely in capital letters, as it can come across as shouting. It seems you're unfamiliar with the basics of analog inputs on [product_name]. Typically, 0 mA corresponds to 0 units, 4 mA to 200 units, and so on up to 20 mA equaling 1000 units. If you set the analog amplifier to a 4-20 mA sensor type, 4 mA will be 0 units, but 0 mA will show as -400 units due to a gain of 2.00 and an offset of -400. Review the screenshot in my previous post: the Minimum parameter is set to -400 and the Maximum to 1600.
